text.p: These are the leading stories in the Lebanese press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Private sector to lobby at two-day economic summit. Business puts its case for new economic deal.
- Saudi medalist disqualified for doping at Pan Arab Games in Beirut.
- Solidere's non-Arab investors plan stirs up land rights row. Solidere, a real estate firm, is Lebanon's biggest company.
- Ministers to meet private sector in economic forum.
- At the economic conference, the government will focus on finance and economic institutions will concentrate on reducing the debt.
- Economic institutions will call for the freezing of the internal debt at the economic summit.
- Will economists tell Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri the truth at the economic conference?
